evidence.evidence_text: As an alternative, we propose a new debiasing framework that introduces binary classifiers between the auxiliary model and the main model, coined bias experts.

Despite the promising debiasing results of recent works, the multi-class learning objective, which has been naively used to train the auxiliary model, may harm the bias mitigation effect due to its regularization effect and competitive nature across classes.
Specifically, each bias expert is trained on a binary classification task derived from the multi-class classification task via the One-vs-Rest approach.
